# MPLOYEDIN
> AI-Powered International Recruitment Platform for the Gulf region

MPLOYEDIN is a dual-sided recruitment marketplace connecting Gulf-region employers
with international job seekers using AI-powered candidate matching.

## Public Pages

- /en/: Platform homepage
- /en/jobs: Browse active job listings across UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman
- /en/blog: Recruitment insights, Gulf job market trends, hiring guides
- /en/faq: Frequently asked questions about the platform
- /en/about: About MPLOYEDIN
- /en/contact: Contact information

## Arabic (RTL) versions available at /ar/
